name: team-pulse
description: Prepares a manager's 1:1s: for each person on the team (the people active in the repository or project you name over the last 2 weeks, up to 10, or the people you name), it reads pull requests opened and reviewed, review turnaround, commits, in-progress tickets and how long they have sat, and chat message counts and timing (never message text). It flags patterns, not judgments: review load concentrated on one person, a ticket 7+ days in its status with no comment, a much quieter week than that person's own usual, more commits outside their working hours than usual. Each person is compared only with their own previous 4 weeks, every signal links its evidence, and it shows a team view of review load and blocked work. Read-only: it never posts, comments, messages anyone or changes anything. It does not rank, rate or compare people, and refuses rather than guessing when the tools are not connected.

skills.name: Team pulse for 1:1s
skills.description: Per-person signal cards for the last 2 weeks against each person's own previous 4 weeks (code host, tracker, chat counts), with evidence links, plus a team view of review load and blocked work. Read-only; no ranking or judgments.
examples: Team pulse for the payments-api repo
